items.title: Instinct’s App Is Fueled by Travel — Founder Says It’s Half of Volume
items.summary: Instinct got travel's attention by handling bookings via text message. Now the real question is whether it can turn that volume into revenue — and travel may be the test case.

items.title: Airbnb CEO on Hotels, Cars, and Flights: ‘I Had to Get Over My Ideology’
items.summary: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky didn't address at length his changing views about Airbnb experiences, but there, too, he's softened his old religion about them having to be unique, and has added mainstream tours and activities.

items.title: How Hotel CEOs Are Really Using AI, From Voice Agents to a Digital Hyatt CEO
items.summary: Hilton, Hyatt, Accor, Wyndham, and Banyan Group all agree AI should make staff better at their jobs. But they split on how to adopt it.

items.title: Uber Is Coming for STR. Airbnb Has an AI Agent Coming.
items.summary: On Monday's ⁠Good Morning Hospitality, A Skift Podcast⁠, ⁠Brandreth Canaley⁠, ⁠Michael Goldin⁠, and ⁠Jamie Lane⁠ recap sessions from Skift Global Forum that every STR operator should be paying attention to.

items.title: How L Catterton Quietly Became One of Travel’s Most Interesting Investors
items.summary: LVMH’s connection gets the attention, but L Catterton’s travel story is really about a $40 billion consumer-investment machine putting more capital behind how people spend their time and discretionary income.

items.title: Accor’s Nicolas Maynard on Closing AI’s Industrialization Gap
items.summary: Industrializing AI across European markets is the hard part at Accor. Its AI chief bets on autonomous agents anyway, though he warns they meet far more friction in the enterprise.

items.title: Bangkok Floods Disrupt Airports, Spare the Hotels — For Now
items.summary: Bangkok’s floods strained airport operations, not hotel demand. The next risk is Golden Week, when rain could complicate travel for a surge of Chinese visitors.

items.title: Faster Dinners, Bigger Ships: How Carnival Is Adjusting to New Passenger Habits
items.summary: Carnival Cruise Line is sitting out the premium push that's reshaping airlines and hotels, betting instead on drive-to affordability and multigenerational families.
